title: Python for Automation Testing
overview: This course is designed to teach participants how to use Python for automation testing, covering unit testing, web testing, API testing, and performance testing. Participants will learn to use testing frameworks like Selenium, PyTest, Unittest, and Behave to create reliable, scalable, and efficient test automation suites. The course includes hands-on exercises, real-world scenarios, and a capstone project to reinforce learning.
audience: Software Testers & QA Engineers who want to automate testing processes
Developers looking to integrate automated testing into their workflow
DevOps Engineers aiming to include testing in CI/CD pipelines
Business Analysts & IT Professionals involved in software quality assurance
Students & Enthusiasts seeking a career in test automation
methodology: Hands-on Practice – Implementing automation scripts in real-world scenarios
Live Demonstrations – Creating and executing automation test cases
Case Studies & Best Practices – Learning from industry-standard testing practices
Collaborative Learning – Group discussions, peer code reviews, and challenges
Capstone Project – Developing a full automation testing framework
competencies: API Testing using Python and Requests Library
Integrating Test Automation with CI/CD Pipelines
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Write automated test scripts using Python
Use Selenium to automate web application testing
Perform API testing using Requests and PyTest
Apply BDD principles with Behave for automation
Integrate automation testing into CI/CD workflows
Generate and interpret detailed test reports
